say:2:1430108101:1.text: My tools, the ones I use for smithing and crafting, have been acting up recently, which has slowed down my work.
say:2:1430108101:1.source_cn: 是我用来锻造的工具们，它们最近在闹别扭，这很影响我干活...

say:3:1430108102:1.text: At this time, you should pray to Helthor and sing Helthor's prayers to make your tools reconcile.
say:3:1430108102:1.source_cn: 这种时候你应该向赫托祈祷，唱起赫托颂歌让工具们和好如初。

say:4:1430108103:1.text: All hail Helthor, mighty and grand. The volcano roared at his command, and diamonds sprang from clay and sand! His bellows blow with sacred might. The fiercest flames burn pure and bright to temper the ore perfectly right!
say:4:1430108103:1.source_cn: 感谢赫托！他以火山为炉，将泥土炼成钻石。在他的教授下，...

say:5:1430108104:1.text: Praise Helthor! The eternal forge of the world is his altar on Esperia. We are forged by his furnace, and as long as fire flares, his name will live on forever!
say:5:1430108104:1.source_cn: 赞美赫托！世上不灭的炉，是他于人间的坛。我们锤铸于炉边...
